summary: AITrade Pro fresh build tested end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass (health, watchlist GET/POST + persistence + invalid-symbol filter, dashboard for crypto+stock across all 8 timeframes, chart endpoints for BTC/BBCA, invalid symbol -> 404, invalid timeframe -> 400, ensemble analyze for crypto and stock with all 3 models named correctly (Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.2, Gemini 3.1 Pro) and >=1 ok=true, no Mongo _id leakage). One backend bug FOUND AND FIXED: indicators.compute_signal short-circuit branch (candles < 20) was missing 'reasons' key which caused KeyError -> 500 on dashboard for 12h/18h/24h timeframes (where Yahoo daily candles for stocks are <20). Added reasons:[] to that branch (/app/backend/indicators.py). After fix all timeframes return 200. Frontend: Dashboard renders two columns CRYPTO (21) + SAHAM (18) with signal pills (BUY/SELL/HOLD), %, sparklines, AI confidence. Timeframe pills switch data. Theme toggle works (dark <-> light). Tapping an asset card navigates to /asset/<market>/<symbol>?timeframe=.. and renders chart, technical indicators (RSI/EMA20/EMA50/MACD H), entry/SL/TP. ANALISA AI button (testID=run-ai-analysis-button) triggers POST analyze; consensus pill + all three model chips render with confidence; news factors section shown. Manage screen opens, CRYPTO/SAHAM tab switching works, SIMPAN persists and navigates back. No red screen, no console errors.

minor.issue: Transient 404s observed when upstream (Binance/Yahoo) momentarily rate-limits under concurrent test load; backend should arguably distinguish upstream-failure (502/503) from real not-found (404). Retry succeeds immediately.

issues: Helper text below ANALISA AI button reads 'Claude Sonnet 4.6 + GPT-5.4 + Gemini 3.1 Pro' but actual model used is GPT-5.2 (see ai_engine.py MODELS). Update copy at /app/frontend/app/asset/[market]/[symbol].tsx:252.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a third-party RN/RNW component; non-blocking but should be triaged.

action_items: (Optional) Distinguish upstream data unavailability from symbol-not-found in chart/analyze endpoints (return 503 when upstream fails, 404 only if symbol unknown).
Fix detail-screen copy: 'GPT-5.4' -> 'GPT-5.2' to match ai_engine.py MODELS list.
Investigate pointerEvents deprecation warning (RNW version mismatch in a dependency).
critical_code_review_comments: indicators.compute_signal: early-return branch omitted 'reasons' key -> KeyError in server._build_signal whenever candles<20 (occurred on Yahoo daily intervals for stocks at 12h/18h/24h timeframes). Fixed by including reasons:[].
ai_engine: confidence ceiling capped at 98 (consistent with spec).
server.py uses Literal types and proper validation; MongoDB queries exclude _id correctly (projection {'_id':0}); no _id leakage in any tested endpoint.
CORS allow_origins='*' acceptable for no-login public app.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (dashboard, navigation, detail, analyze, theme toggle, manage screen save)

seed_data_creation: None. Watchlist auto-initializes on first GET. Tests restore the original watchlist after the update-persistence test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at http://localhost:8001, public URL https://cryptostock-pro.preview.emergentagent.com. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is set. Analyze endpoint takes ~15-45s (3 LLMs in parallel). Yahoo Finance daily intervals can return <20 candles for certain stocks at long timeframes (12h/18h/24h) — indicators must gracefully handle short candle arrays.
rca_of_issue: Bug: GET /api/dashboard?market=stock&timeframe=12h|18h|24h returned 500. Root cause: in indicators.compute_signal, when len(candles)<20 the returned dict lacked the 'reasons' key, but server._build_signal unconditionally does sig['reasons'] -> KeyError -> 500. Fix: add 'reasons': [] to the early-return dict. Reproduction: curl /api/dashboard?market=stock&timeframe=24h before fix -> 500; after fix -> 200.
